important_documents.summary: Today’s through-line is straightforward: the EEA Joint Committee has continued its steady programme of “legal alignment by incorporation” in financial services, with one decision also extending that alignment into company law. Across five separate measures adopted on 5 December 2025, the EEA Agreement’s Annex IX (Financial services) is amended repeatedly, updating which EU rules apply in Iceland, Liechtenstein and Norway.
